rv.q: So much grander than the sum of its parts, ADRIFT resists ever being cornered into one small thing.
"ADRIFT" is a masterclass in world-building with nothing but words, gestures, a few drums, and raw imagination.
Happenstance conjures an atmosphere through sensory touchstones that rivals any of the far more elaborate sets recently on local stages.
The delightfully inventive show is full of physical comedy, music, puppetry, dance, and striking visual imagery that lingers in the mind.

cn.t: Happenstance Theatre's inventive medieval tale earns strong praise for its physical comedy, puppetry, and striking visual imagery that captures humanity's struggles with wit and whimsy.
